toast_errorCreatingFolderDesc.description: Toast description when creating a folder fails

toast_itemRemovedDesc.description: Toast description after removing a bookmark or folder

toast_errorDeletingBookmarkDesc.message: Failed to delete bookmark. Please try again.
toast_errorDeletingBookmarkDesc.description: Toast description when deleting a bookmark fails

toast_errorDeletingFolderDesc.message: Failed to delete folder. Please try again.
toast_errorDeletingFolderDesc.description: Toast description when deleting a folder fails

toast_itemMovedDesc.description: Toast description after moving an item into another folder

toast_itemReorderedDesc.description: Toast description after reordering an item inside its folder; $2 is the 1-based position

toast_reorderHiddenBySort.message: The list is sorted by date or name, so the saved order is only visible with the "Folders First" sort order.
toast_reorderHiddenBySort.description: Note added to the reorder toast when the popup sort order hides browser order

toast_errorMovingItemDesc.message: Failed to move item. Please try again.
toast_errorMovingItemDesc.description: Toast description when moving an item fails

toast_cannotMoveIntoDescendant.message: A folder can't be moved into itself or one of its subfolders.
toast_cannotMoveIntoDescendant.description: Toast description when a folder is dropped into itself or one of its subfolders

popup_expandAllSubfolders.description: Tooltip and accessible label for the folder action that opens the folder and every subfolder

popup_collapseAllSubfolders.description: Tooltip and accessible label for the folder action that closes every subfolder

action_close.description: Accessible label for close buttons on dialogs, panels, and notifications

toast_regionLabel.description: Accessible name of the notifications region; keep {hotkey} unchanged, it is replaced with the keyboard shortcut

toast_itemLabel.description: Accessible label announced for each notification
